note: Cold open (24_NARRATIVE_REVISION §7.1 beats 2-4, task M1-51): the v7 shots re-edited with no dialogue. Shot A holds wide for 2 s in total silence, then accelerates to the station and dives through the porthole into the commons (shot B) as the fans fade in; a push-in ends on the gold band of the battery hologram under the title. The EX-CH01-S01 lines play in-engine at the mission table (M1-49); CUE-01 enters after the charter. Shot C (Ferreira on the Earth screen) is unused.
